entities.summary: Wolfgang Mückstein is an Austrian physician and politician. He served as Minister for Social Affairs, Health, Care and Consumer Protection in the governments of chancellors Sebastian Kurz, Alexander Schallenberg and Karl Nehammer from 19 April 2021 until 8 March 2022.
